1PE.P.2.1-12.text: The Living Stone and Chosen People

1PE.1.3-5.text: God gives believers new birth and a living hope

1PE.1.6-7.text: Trials test the faith of believers like fire tests gold

1PE.1.8-10.text: Believers love and trust Jesus without seeing him

1PE.1.11-12.text: Prophets foretold Christ’s sufferings and glory

1PE.1.13-14.text: Believers should be alert and set hope on Jesus’ grace

1PE.1.15-17.text: God is holy, so believers must be holy and respect him

1PE.1.18-19.text: Christ’s blood, not silver or gold, set believers free

1PE.1.20-21.text: Christ was known before creation and revealed for believers

1PE.1.22-23.text: Believers are born again and must love one another

1PE.1.24-25.text: God’s word stands forever, but people are like grass

1PE.2.1-3.text: Believers must stop doing evil and crave spiritual milk

1PE.2.4-5.text: Believers are living stones built into a spiritual house

1PE.2.6-6.text: Scripture says God lays a chosen cornerstone in Zion

1PE.2.7-8.text: The stone is precious to believers but makes others stumble

1PE.2.9-10.text: Believers are God’s chosen people who have received mercy

1PE.2.11-12.text: Believers as foreigners must live honorably among Gentiles

1PE.2.13-17.text: Believers must obey rulers and honor everyone

1PE.2.18-20.text: Slaves must respect masters, even when suffering unjustly

1PE.2.21-23.text: Christ suffered without sin and left believers an example

1PE.2.24-25.text: Christ bore our sins, and believers return to the Shepherd

1PE.3.1-2.text: Wives should win unbelieving husbands by good behavior

1PE.3.3-4.text: True beauty for wives is a gentle and quiet spirit

1PE.3.5-6.text: Wives should follow Sarah, who hoped in God

1PE.3.7-7.text: Husbands must treat wives with consideration and honor

1PE.3.8-9.text: Believers should be humble and answer evil with blessing

1PE.3.10-12.text: Believers must turn from evil, do good and seek peace

1PE.3.13-13.text: No one can truly harm believers who do good

1PE.3.14-14.text: Believers who suffer for doing right are blessed

1PE.3.15-17.text: Believers should be ready to explain the hope gently

1PE.3.18-20.text: Christ suffered once for sins and was made alive

1PE.3.21-22.text: Baptism saves believers through Jesus’ resurrection

1PE.4.1-2.text: Believers should live for God’s will, not human desires

1PE.4.3-6.text: Believers have left the sinful life of the Gentiles

1PE.4.7-9.text: Believers should pray, love each other and show hospitality

1PE.4.10-11.text: Believers should use God’s gifts to serve each other

1PE.4.12-14.text: Believers should not be surprised by suffering for Christ

1PE.4.15-16.text: Believers should not be ashamed to suffer as Christians

1PE.4.17-19.text: Believers who suffer should trust God and keep doing good

1PE.5.5-7.text: Young men obey elders; all believers should be humble

1PE.5.8-9.text: Believers must watch for the devil and resist him

1PE.5.10-11.text: God will restore and strengthen believers after suffering

1PE.5.12-14.text: Peter ends his letter with greetings and peace
